lines.beaver: 여기 정말 넓네요. 화장실은 어디 있을까요?
lines.beaver_en: It's really big here. Where might the restroom be?
lines.beaver_roman: yeogi jeongmal neomneyo. hwajangsireun eodi isseulkkayo?
lines.en: That corner over there seems to be the restroom.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, you're right. Where's the emergency exit?
lines.learner: 복도 양쪽 끝의 초록 불이 비상구인 모양이에요.
lines.en: The green lights at both ends of the hall seem to be exits.
lines.roman: bokdo yangjjok kkeute chorok buri bisangguin moyangieyo.

lines.beaver_en: So many people, it's hectic. What about the info desk?
lines.en: The space across from the entrance seems to be the info center.

lines.beaver_en: Which floor is the event hall on?
lines.en: The middle area on the 2nd floor seems to be the event hall.

lines.beaver_en: This building has so many facilities.

lines.en: The corner on the right seems to be the dining area.

lines.beaver_en: Is there a place to rest with coffee?
lines.learner: 건물 뒤 야외 공간이 카페인 모양이에요.
lines.en: The outdoor space behind the building seems to be a café.
lines.roman: geonmul dwi yaoe gongani kapein moyangieyo.

lines.beaver_en: By the way, where did we park the car?
lines.learner: 건물 앞뒤에 주차장이 있어요. 우리는 뒤쪽이에요.
lines.en: There are lots in front and back. We're in the back.
lines.roman: geonmul apdwie juchajangi isseoyo. urineun dwijjogieyo.

lines.beaver_en: We'll have to look around everywhere today.
lines.learner: 네, 넓으니까 길 잃지 않게 같이 다녀요.
lines.en: Yes, it's big, so let's stick together so we don't get lost.
lines.roman: ne, neolbeunikka gil ilchi anke gachi danyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, okay. Let's head to the event hall now.
lines.en: Okay. Those stairs seem to be the shortcut.
